title: Codex Security rank-input helper omits all Framework PR #30 staged CI and test files
title_de: Codex-Security-Rank-Input-Helper lässt alle gestagten CI- und Testdateien von Framework-PR #30 aus
summary: The Codex Security rank-input helper completed successfully in local-patch mode for Framework PR #30 but emitted zero worklist rows even though Git reported fourteen explicitly staged refactor files. Its static EXCLUDED_DIRS excludes ci and tests, which removes the changed executable CI helpers and regression tests from the generated worklist. A manually reconstructed exact staged-file inventory restored all fourteen files to the security-diff worklist, so no PR #30 code was left unreviewed. The external-tool defect remains independently actionable.
summary_de: Der Codex-Security-Rank-Input-Helper wurde im Local-Patch-Modus für Framework-PR #30 erfolgreich beendet, gab aber null Worklist-Zeilen aus, obwohl Git vierzehn explizit gestagte Refaktor-Dateien meldete. Seine statische EXCLUDED_DIRS schließt ci und tests aus und entfernt dadurch die geänderten ausführbaren CI-Helfer und Regressionstests aus der generierten Worklist. Eine manuell rekonstruierte exakte Staged-File-Inventur führte alle vierzehn Dateien wieder in die Security-Diff-Worklist über, sodass kein PR-#30-Code ungeprüft blieb. Der externe Tool-Defekt bleibt unabhängig bearbeitbar.
observed_behavior: generate_rank_input.py make-diff-rank-input returned exit code 0 with zero rows against base 504c8f164d4dab4bc857718af0233557ad48f727, while the same task worktree had fourteen explicitly staged ACMR files. The helper's static EXCLUDED_DIRS contains ci and tests. The recovered rank_input.jsonl and deep_review_input.jsonl each contain fourteen rows matching the exact sorted staged Git inventory.
observed_behavior_de: generate_rank_input.py make-diff-rank-input lieferte gegen Basis 504c8f164d4dab4bc857718af0233557ad48f727 Exit-Code 0 mit null Zeilen, während derselbe Task-Worktree vierzehn explizit gestagte ACMR-Dateien hatte. Die statische EXCLUDED_DIRS des Helpers enthält ci und tests. Die wiederhergestellten rank_input.jsonl und deep_review_input.jsonl enthalten jeweils vierzehn Zeilen, die der exakten sortierten Staged-Git-Inventur entsprechen.
expected_behavior: For a local-patch security-diff scan, the rank-input helper must emit a review row for every changed CI and test file, including paths under ci and tests, or fail loudly and nonzero with a coverage diagnostic. The scan must have an automated regression that compares emitted worklist coverage with the authoritative staged Git inventory before downstream review consumes the worklist.
expected_behavior_de: Für einen Local-Patch-Security-Diff-Scan muss der Rank-Input-Helper für jede geänderte CI- und Testdatei, einschließlich Pfaden unter ci und tests, eine Review-Zeile ausgeben oder mit einer Coverage-Diagnose laut und nichtnull fehlschlagen. Der Scan muss eine automatisierte Regression besitzen, die die ausgegebene Worklist-Coverage mit der autoritativen Staged-Git-Inventur vergleicht, bevor die Downstream-Review die Worklist verwendet.
impact: A successful but empty security-diff worklist can falsely suggest that no relevant code exists and could omit security-sensitive CI helpers or regression controls from review. This record does not establish an exploitable Framework vulnerability. The current PR #30 scan was contained by manual exact-inventory recovery and full-file review receipts for all fourteen files, so it is not a release blocker for this PR; future scans remain at risk until the external helper and its regression coverage are corrected.
impact_de: Eine erfolgreich beendete, aber leere Security-Diff-Worklist kann fälschlich nahelegen, dass kein relevanter Code vorhanden ist, und sicherheitssensitive CI-Helfer oder Regression-Controls aus dem Review auslassen. Dieser Record belegt keine ausnutzbare Framework-Schwachstelle. Der aktuelle PR-#30-Scan wurde durch manuelle Exact-Inventory-Recovery und Full-File-Review-Receipts für alle vierzehn Dateien eingegrenzt, daher ist er kein Release-Blocker für diesen PR; zukünftige Scans bleiben bis zur Korrektur des externen Helpers und seiner Regression-Coverage gefährdet.
preconditions: The Framework PR #30 task worktree has fourteen explicitly staged ACMR refactor files relative to 504c8f164d4dab4bc857718af0233557ad48f727.
The Codex Security generate_rank_input.py helper is invoked with make-diff-rank-input in local-patch mode.
The helper retains static EXCLUDED_DIRS entries for ci and tests.

evidence.summary: The helper completed successfully with zero rows despite fourteen staged Framework PR #30 refactor files. The retained result records the static ci and tests exclusion cause.

evidence.command: rtk git -C /var/tmp/codex/ModSecurity-conector/runs/20260719T230508Z-framework-pr30-duplication-master-37469460/tmp/worktrees/framework-pr30-duplication-master diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR 504c8f164d4dab4bc857718af0233557ad48f727; recover rank_input.jsonl and deep_review_input.jsonl from the exact sorted inventory
evidence.summary: The manual recovery records why the zero-row helper output is invalid for this diff and confirms that all fourteen staged files were deliberately returned to the downstream security-diff worklist.

evidence.command: Current user explicitly accepted local archival because no external Codex Security helper repair is currently available; policy review preserved accepted_risk rather than technical closure.
evidence.summary: The current user accepts this unresolved external-tool coverage gap only for the local test archive. Future local-patch scans can still omit changed ci/tests paths until the helper is repaired and regression-tested.

root_cause: The external Codex Security helper applies a static directory exclusion policy that treats ci and tests as non-reviewable in local-patch mode. That policy is incompatible with this Framework repository, where CI helpers and regression tests implement and verify security-relevant controls. Successful completion does not compare its empty selection with the authoritative staged Git inventory and therefore does not fail closed.
root_cause_de: Der externe Codex-Security-Helper wendet im Local-Patch-Modus eine statische Directory-Exclusion-Policy an, die ci und tests als nicht reviewbar behandelt. Diese Policy ist mit diesem Framework-Repository unvereinbar, in dem CI-Helfer und Regressionstests sicherheitsrelevante Controls implementieren und verifizieren. Die erfolgreiche Beendigung vergleicht ihre leere Auswahl nicht mit der autoritativen Staged-Git-Inventur und schlägt daher nicht fail closed fehl.
proposed_remediation: In the external Codex Security tooling, remove the unconditional local-patch exclusion of changed ci and tests paths, or make a zero-coverage condition a nonzero failure with a precise diagnostic. Add an automated fixture that stages changed ci and tests files, asserts complete rank-input coverage, and verifies that the downstream deep-review input preserves the same path set. No external-tool remediation is in scope for Framework PR #30.
proposed_remediation_de: Im externen Codex-Security-Tooling die bedingungslose Local-Patch-Exclusion geänderter ci- und tests-Pfade entfernen oder eine Zero-Coverage-Bedingung mit präziser Diagnose als nichtnullen Fehler behandeln. Eine automatisierte Fixture hinzufügen, die geänderte ci- und tests-Dateien staged, vollständige Rank-Input-Coverage prüft und verifiziert, dass der Downstream-Deep-Review-Input dieselbe Pfadmenge bewahrt. Keine externe Tool-Remediation liegt im Scope von Framework PR #30.
acceptance_criteria: The local-patch rank-input helper emits rows for every changed CI and test file, including all paths under ci and tests, or exits nonzero with a precise coverage diagnostic.
An automated regression stages representative ci and tests files and proves that rank_input.jsonl and deep_review_input.jsonl preserve the complete authoritative Git path set.
The scanner validates its generated worklist against the authoritative staged Git inventory before it can report a no-files result.
A rerun on the fourteen-file PR #30 fixture reports all fourteen reviewable paths without manual replacement.
No Framework source, test, CI, SonarQube setting, security control, Parent gitlink, or MRTS state is weakened or changed to hide this tooling defect.
validation_plan: Run an external-tool regression fixture with changed ci and tests paths and compare its rank-input output with git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR.
Assert that an empty generated worklist with a nonempty authoritative inventory fails nonzero and includes a coverage diagnostic.
Rerun a focused security-diff scan after the external-tool repair and verify complete work-ledger receipts for each emitted path.
Reconfirm that Framework PR #30 retains its manual fourteen-file recovery evidence until the external-tool remediation has independently passed.
regression_tests: Codex Security external-tool local-patch rank-input coverage fixture for changed ci and tests files
Codex Security external-tool worklist-versus-staged-Git-inventory parity test
legitimate_control_tests: A nonempty staged diff containing ci and tests paths produces matching rank-input and deep-review worklist rows.
A genuinely empty staged diff may report zero rows without a false coverage failure.
A nonempty staged diff whose generated worklist is empty fails with a precise coverage diagnostic.
dependencies: Codex Security external-tool maintainer and release process
The retained Framework PR #30 local-patch scan evidence
blocked_by: External Codex Security helper ownership and release process; no Framework source change can repair the worklist coverage defect.
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-FRAMEWORK-0023 or FND-FRAMEWORK-0024. Those findings own a SonarQube duplication remediation and a Change Record contract failure in Framework PR #30. This finding owns the independently reproducible external scanner worklist-selection defect that could have excluded their changed CI and test code from security review.
evidence_limitations: The retained evidence proves the local-patch behavior for one fourteen-file staged Framework diff; it does not establish behavior for every scanner mode or every file type.
The helper itself is external tooling, so this finding does not authorize editing its source from the Framework task.
Manual recovery contains the current PR #30 scan only; it is not a substitute for an automated external-tool regression.
residual_risk: The current user accepts this unresolved external-tool gap only for the local test archive. Until the helper is repaired and regression-tested, future local-patch security-diff scans can silently omit changed CI and test controls. The manual PR #30 recovery covers only that historical scan; no fix, production safety, release readiness, or NGINX upstream-digest substitute is claimed.
residual_risk_de: Der aktuelle Nutzer akzeptiert diese ungelöste External-Tool-Lücke nur für das lokale Testarchiv. Bis der Helper repariert und regressionsgetestet ist, können zukünftige Local-Patch-Security-Diff-Scans geänderte CI- und Test-Controls stillschweigend auslassen. Die manuelle PR-#30-Recovery deckt nur diesen historischen Scan ab; kein Fix, keine Produktionssicherheit, keine Release-Reife und kein Ersatz für einen NGINX-Upstream-Digest werden beansprucht.

history.detail: The Codex Security helper completed at exit code 0 with zero rows against base 504c8f164d4dab4bc857718af0233557ad48f727 while the Framework PR #30 task worktree held fourteen staged ACMR files. Static EXCLUDED_DIRS entries for ci and tests caused the omission.

The exact sorted staged Git inventory was restored into rank_input.jsonl and deep_review_input.jsonl with fourteen rows each. The current PR #30 scan therefore has no unreviewed staged code, while the external-tool remediation remains out of scope.

The current user explicitly accepted that no external helper repair is currently available and selected local archival. Status changed from validated to accepted_risk, not closed: the external-tool remediation and regression criteria remain required before production, publication, release, or technical closure.
